en: Kuba's bike padlock. The photo and receipt matched the bike. Tie straightened twice. Bus at eight fifty-two.
pl: Kuba, kłódka rowerowa. Zdjęcie i paragon, rzecz w posiadaniu. Krawat poprawiony dwa razy. Autobus o ósmej pięćdziesiąt dwie.

en: Mrs Halina, city center. Mrs Zosia confirms forty years next door. Broth reduced. I had a bowl.
Liège, three fifty in the morning. Detector lock did its job. Handover papers in order. A pearl-sugar waffle.
pl: Liège, trzecia pięćdziesiąt. Zamek z detektorem miał rację, że się zablokował. Papiery przejęcia w porządku. Gofr z perłowym cukrem.

en: Newlyweds, four twelve in the morning. Address confirmed by app and a neighbor in a robe. Three-tier cake. I had a slice.
pl: Nowożeńcy, czwarta dwanaście. Dowód bez adresu to norma, dlatego meldunek i sąsiad w szlafroku. Tort trzypiętrowy, wziąłem kawałek.

en: One in the morning, a suit, a rush, cash instead of a witness. Didn't open. Reported it. Slept well.
Room four hundred twelve, campus. The porter checked his residents' list; the name matched. Zuzanna asked about everything.
pl: Pokój czterysta dwanaście, kampus. Portier z listą lokatorów: najlepszy dowód, jaki istnieje. Zuzanna pytała o wszystko.

en: Class three B, under the chestnut tree. School approval, twenty witnesses. Marta was there. Note at home: "Broth's waiting."
pl: Klasa trzecia B, kasztanowiec. Dyrekcja i dwudziestu świadków. Marta była w tej klasie. Na wycieraczce kartka: „Rosół czeka”.

en: Museum of Technology. Doctor Rygiel filed everything in triplicate. The time lock was repaired. Zuzanna is interning, of course.
pl: Muzeum Techniki. Doktor Rygiel, trzy egzemplarze wszystkiego. Zegar naprawiony. Zuzanna jest tu na stażu, oczywiście.

en: Got your allotment card? And a neighbor to vouch for you?
Lease, address from the commune, and a neighbor. That's enough. Please don't lean over the railing.
I know them. Married today. The whole neighborhood heard the party.
Mrs Agnieszka, after a night shift. Mr Roman on the intercom, efficient as ever. Neighbor discount, no question.
Renata's pizzeria. Lease and neighbor checked. Paid in margherita pizza. Box is on my shelf.
The aunt was alive and well. The neighbor appeared just in time. Mrs Lucyna sends regards from her retreat.
Mr Władysław, Świątniki. Recognized Henryk's handwriting in my notebook. Taught him the first rule.
The store is on my list. It belonged to the old theater.
Campus theater store. Mr Edek and university approval; chairs on loan for the residents' meeting.
I bought the whole bench. The drawer doesn't recognize the invoice.
The lease matches. Your neighbor confirms this is your studio.
Marta's studio. Lease and neighbor. The posters were collected; Potato declined to comment.
Museum, catalogue drawer. Doctor Rygiel approved the copies. The originals stayed where they belong.
